items.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: First of all I grew up with Mingus, I mean, you know, from the time I guess 14, 15 years old when he used to hang out with Buddy, you know.

ctx.x: And you know, the place opened up, you know. And they went down south and got all the rednecks to come out there and become cops.

Yeah, well that’s what precipitated the Black Panthers but we’re getting ahead of ourselves. So looking back again at your early childhood in Los Angeles, I know that your wife Helen was mentioning, you know, Charles Mingus, her experience with Charles Mingus in Sunday school and she said that, you know, he was a bad boy, the AME Methodist. So you didn’t mention your first meeting. You did talk at length about meeting Eric but we didn’t talk about your meeting with Mingus and Illinois, Jack, Ed, and Buddy…
